title: Receipted delivery: clear message_id and attempt_key on return to pending, and bound the persisted retry entry
outcome: Receipted delivery: clear message_id and attempt_key on return to pending, and bound the persisted retry entry
acceptance: Every path that returns a receipt to pending clears its message_id and attempt_key, and a test asserts it
The persisted retry entry of settled receipts is bounded in size or count beyond the receipt limit, with a test showing the bound
